name: Hotel Hirschen
beschreibung: Hotel Hirschen is centrally located in Imst within Tyrol's scenic Upper Inn Valley. The hotel blends alpine coziness with modern amenities and attentive service. Guests can relax in the wellness area featuring a Finnish sauna and steam bath, or dine in the restaurant serving authentic regional specialties. Winter brings quick connections to the Hoch-Imst ski area and nearby glacier resorts, while summer offers pristine hiking in the Lechtal Alps.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Hirschen in Imst provides traditional Tyrolean comfort, a Finnish sauna and steam bath, hearty dining, and easy access to Oberinntal skiing and hiking trails.
